name: tflw
description: testFlow CLI — an external DSL (.tflw files) for API, browser and load testing in one language: config as tflw itself, sessions, capture-chaining, hooks/retry/tags, actions+JS escape hatch, real Playwright browser automation, ramp/hold/step/spike workloads with thresholds, teaching-quality diagnostics, a Language Server, and a self-contained report.html + junit.xml + results.json.
author: Deepak Tuteja <tuteja123@gmail.com>

scripts._test note: `--test-concurrency=1` is load-bearing, not a tuning knob. Four files here (e2e, watch, pick, lsp) each run `npm run build` at the REPO ROOT; run two at once and the root builds race on `.vitepress/.temp` and on each other's `dist/`, which surfaces as ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND here and as deep-equal/undefined failures in @tflw/runtime and @tflw/lsp-server importing a `dist/` mid-rewrite. Measured 2026-08-22: 307 phantom failures. See CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Run the suite with `npm test`, not package by package'.
scripts._docs:gen note: `M147e`/`M147-10`: this chains lang's docs:CHECK, not its docs:gen. SPEC.md is committed, so the right thing to do about a mismatch is fail; `docs-data.generated.ts` is gitignored, so the right thing to do about it is write it. Two outputs, two verbs. Fix a failure with `npm run docs:gen -w @tflw/lang`.
scripts.prepack: npm run build --prefix ../.. -w @tflw/lang -w @tflw/runtime -w @tflw/reporter -w @tflw/lsp-server && npm run build
